source_row.rationale: Theophylline has a narrow therapeutic range. Nausea/vomiting, tremor, palpitations and tachyarrhythmias can occur with excessive exposure. Erythromycin can inhibit theophylline clearance and raise concentrations. When toxicity is suspected, labeling advises withholding additional theophylline and measuring the serum concentration promptly.
source_row.source_detail: DailyMed theophylline extended-release label — Drug Interactions entry for erythromycin plus toxicity-response guidance to withhold further doses and obtain a serum concentration when toxicity is suspected. source_row.stem: A client stable on theophylline starts erythromycin and several days later develops persistent nausea, tremor, palpitations, and tachycardia. What should the nurse suspect?
